prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Phoenix car-accident lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, insurance coverage, whether fault is disputed, and whether the case may need trial.

For a serious Phoenix car-accident case, look for a lawyer or firm that:

- Handles auto-injury litigation regularly, not just settlements.
- Has documented trial and verdict experience in Arizona.
- Will personally review your case rather than immediately routing it to a case manager.
- Works on contingency and explains the fee, expenses, and what happens if there is no recovery.
- Has no conflict with the other driver, insurer, or involved businesses.

Well-known Phoenix-area personal-injury firms you could compare include **Knapp & Roberts**, **Breyer Law Offices**, **Phillips Law Group**, **Goldberg & Osborne**, **Lerner and Rowe**, and **Zanes Law**. Recognition or advertising alone does not mean one is best; ask each firm who would actually handle your case and whether they have taken similar cases to trial.

A good screening question is:

> “Have you tried Arizona car-accident cases involving injuries and insurance limits similar to mine? Who will be my day-to-day lawyer, and what is your contingency fee plus case-cost policy?”

You can also verify discipline history and license status through the **State Bar of Arizona** and seek referrals through its lawyer-referral resources.

Do not wait too long: Arizona injury claims often have a **two-year filing deadline**, and claims involving a government vehicle or entity can have much shorter notice requirements.
